raw.description:
About the opportunity

Join our Education team as a Customer Success Manager (Enterprise) in Melbourne, Australia to make a real impact every day. We say that because we know that every conversation we have, every code line we write and every interface we design is another opportunity for us to elevate everyday life experiences for our customers and the people and communities they serve.

Reporting into the Director of Customer Success Account Management, you will help us strengthen the partnership between Xplor Education and the early childhood education and care (ECEC) providers we support, driving customer outcomes that improve operational efficiency, family engagement, and quality care. Some of the other responsibilities include:

- Maintain active account plans for all assigned enterprise customers, including documented stakeholder lists, executive engagement strategies, risks, opportunities, and success plans
- Deliver agreed customer engagement and review cadences, including quarterly business reviews, customer health scoring, and product and feature adoption reviews
- Proactively identify, mitigate, and manage churn risks across your portfolio of strategic customers
- Manage contract renewals end-to-end, including commercial negotiation and identification of revenue growth opportunities
- Deliver cross-sell, upsell, migration, and product adoption targets in collaboration with Account Executives
- Maintain accurate and timely customer records, opportunities, account plans, and activities within Salesforce, using tools such as Salesloft to record interactions and drive engagement
- Manage customer support escalations through to resolution, coordinating internal stakeholders as required
- Champion customer feedback and requirements internally, ensuring customer needs are effectively represented across Product, Engineering, Support, and other business functions
- Contribute to product adoption, customer education, enablement, and change management initiatives, including supporting QikKids to Office migrations

Location - Remote within Australia, with a preference for Melbourne-based candidates and full Australian working rights. Expect occasional travel (roughly 2–3 times a year)

What would make me a good candidate?

We are looking for curious and empathetic people. We also love to hear from people who are motivated by meaningful work, resonate with our core values, have a positive outlook, are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive working in an ever-evolving and complex environment. We are inspired by meeting big-picture thinkers and doers, people who can be both tactical and strategic, aim high and put people first in everything they do.

You'll need:

  • 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Sales, Relationship Management, or a similar customer-facing role
  • Proven experience managing complex customer relationships and multiple stakeholders, including executive-level decision-makers
  • Strong commercial acumen with a track record of leading contract renewals, negotiating commercial outcomes, and identifying growth opportunities
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence outcomes across internal and external audiences
  • Strong problem-solving, organisational, and account planning capabilities
  • Experience delivering customer enablement, workshops, product demonstrations, or training programs
  • Ability to analyse customer needs and develop strategic plans that drive measurable business outcomes
  • Experience working with CRM platforms such as Salesforce

It would be great if you also have:

  • Experience within the Early Childhood Education and Care (ECEC) sector
  • Working knowledge of childcare management software, education technology, SaaS, or related industries
  • Familiarity with Xplor Education products, including Office, Playground, MyWaitlist, Payments, or QikKids
  • Experience supporting software migrations, change management, or digital transformation programs

At Xplor, we believe that the best innovation and ideas happen at the intersections of our differences - people of diverse cultures, generations, disciplines, and lived experiences. So even if you think you do not tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply.

Values and Life at Xplor

Our five core values guide us from how we hire and recognise our team members to how we interact with our customers day to day:

  • Find a better way - We are curious and creative, always looking for smarter solutions
  • Do the right thing - We act with integrity and put people first
  • Say it straight - We communicate openly and honestly
  • Win together - We collaborate across teams and celebrate shared success
  • Own the outcome - We take accountability and follow through

If these values sound like you, and describe people you want to work with, you will thrive at Xplor.

As an Xplorer, you will be part of a global network of talented colleagues who will support your success. We look for commonalities and shared passions and give people the tools they need to deliver great work and grow at speed.

Some of our perks and benefits are:

  • Paid Parental Leave benefit programs
  • #GiveBackDays/Commitment to social impact – 3 extra days off to volunteer and give back to your local community
  • Ongoing dedication to Diversity & Inclusion initiatives such as D&I Council, Global Mentorship Program
  • Access to free mental health support
  • Flexible working arrangements

Ready to apply?

To start your application, please submit your resume, and we will be in touch as soon as we can. Please include the word "moonshot" at the top of your message to the Hiring Manager so that we know you took the time to read our job ad.

We understand that diverse candidates have diverse needs. We welcome you to inform us of any additional needs related to completing your job application or participating in the interview process, via .

More about us

More than 130,000 businesses in 72+ countries rely on Xplor to run their day and get paid, processing over $47 billion in payments annually. Our connected ecosystem helps operators spend less time managing complexity and more time delivering the experiences that matter most.

Xplor is backed by world-class investors Advent International, Battery Ventures, and Silver Lake.

Good to know

To be considered for employment, you must be legally authorised to work in the location (country) you're applying for. Xplor does not sponsor visas, either at the time of hire or at any later time.

We kindly ask you to apply through our careers portal or external job boards only. Please don't send your application via email.

To learn more about us and our products, please visit .

We also invite you to check out our Candidate FAQs for more information about our recruitment process .

EEO and Artificial Intelligence

We believe in transparent hiring. We use an applicant tracking system that includes artificial intelligence enabled features to assist with the screening and assessment of job applications, such as candidate scoring or ranking. These tools support our recruitment process, but all hiring decisions are made by our recruitment team following human review. We do not rely on artificial intelligence to make final hiring decisions. Find our Candidate AI Usage guidelines here.

Xplor is dedicated to attracting, retaining and developing our people regardless of gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability and age. Applications are encouraged from all sectors of the community and we strongly encourage applications from the Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander community.

We make it a priority to respond to every applicant.

Xplor Technologies powers the experiences at the heart of everyday life. Through modern vertical software, embedded payments, and AI-powered capabilities, we help businesses in fitness, recreation, golf and club, field services, laundry, education, and other membership-based and service-based industries simplify operations, uncover insights, and elevate customer and member experiences.

raw.description:
About us

Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.

Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.

About the role

We are looking for motivated candidates who thrive in a high-growth environment to join our Customer Success team. In this role, you will be accountable for providing the highest level of customer support and service to both prospective and current customers, including insurance brokers quoting on our platform and our policyholders.

We believe that when our customers win, we win. You’ll be on the front lines helping customers navigate an intricate, rapidly growing business – from basic company and product education to administrative and transaction support. If you combine a track record of solving customer needs with an incredibly positive attitude and a genuine drive to help others, we’d love to talk with you.

This is an in-office position located in our Provo, UT office or remote if located outside of Utah.

Responsibilities

  • Respond to inbound questions and requests from prospective and current customers via online live chat, email, and (less frequently) phone.
  • Ensure prospective and current customers receive timely, accurate assistance from Coalition’s sales, security, insurance, and claims teams by routing and coordinating inquiries as needed.
  • Educate customers on Coalition’s products, including how to use our online quoting platform (for brokers) and our cybersecurity platform (for insureds).
  • Perform administrative insurance functions to support quoting, binding, policy changes, and other key workflows that keep our growth engine running smoothly.
  • Capture customer feedback, identify recurring pain points, and collaborate with teammates across Coalition to implement organizational and product improvements.
  • Maintain clear, professional, and empathetic communication in every interaction, ensuring customers feel heard, supported, and confident in working with Coalition.

Skills and Qualifications

  • Prior experience in a customer support or customer service role, or a strong demonstrated desire to learn and build these skills.
  • Excellent interactive and communication abilities, both written and verbal, especially in customer-facing environments.
  • Resourceful, enthusiastic, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, start-up environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn new tools, processes, and products quickly, with strong attention to detail.
  • Prior insurance experience is not required, but is a plus.
  • Incredibly positive attitude and a team-first mindset.

Compensation

About the role

We are looking for motivated candidates who thrive in a high growth environment to join our customer success team. Candidates in this role will be accountable for providing the highest level of customer support and service to prospective and current customers (which include both insurance brokers quoting on our platform, as well as our policyholders). We believe 100% that if our customers win, we win. Ideal candidates for the role will have demonstrated experience effectively finding a solution to customer needs in an intricate, rapidly growing business – from basic company and product education to administrative and transaction assistance. Pair that with an incredibly positive attitude, and a drive to help others, then you’re someone we’d love to speak to!

This is an in-office position located in our Provo, UT office or remote if located outside of Utah.

Responsibilities

  • Ensuring prospective and current customers receive the assistance they need from Coalition’s sales, insurance, security and claims teams
  • Answering inbound questions and requests from prospective and current customers over online live chat, e-mail, and (much less frequently) by phone
  • Partner with Team Leads and Operations to identify knowledge gaps, propose training topics, and help translate QA themes into practical coaching or documentation updates
  • Support training & onboarding for new and existing customer success team members
  • Educating customers on Coalition’s product, as well as how to use both our online quoting platform (for brokers) and cybersecurity platform (for insureds)
  • Performing administrative insurance functions to keep our growth engine humming
  • Working with the rest of the Coalition team to implement organizational and product changes that mitigate customer pain points

Skills and Qualifications

  • 3+ years in a customer-facing support, service, operations, or customer success role, ideally in a high-volume B2B environment
  • Demonstrated experience coaching or mentoring peers/new hires in a high-volume customer success, support, or operations environment
  • Experience creating or improving training materials (playbooks, macros, wikis, Looms, or guides) is a strong plus
  • Prior insurance experience is a plus, but not required; strong interest and ability to ramp quickly are essential
  • Demonstrated ability to own and resolve complex customer issues end-to-end, exercising sound judgment on when to self-solve vs. escalate
  • Excellent interactive and communication abilities, both written and verbal, especially in customer-facing roles
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; comfortable working in multiple systems and following structured processes without losing sight of the customer outcome.
  • Resourceful, enthusiastic, and a desire to operate in a start-up environment – if you’re looking for an opportunity to learn and expand your skill set, this is the place!
  • Incredibly positive attitude. Attitude overcomes all!

Compensation

This is a full-time, in-office position based in Provo, UT. The role is classified as non-exempt under FLSA guidelines, which means you're eligible for overtime pay when working more than 40 hours in a week. You may also be eligible for meal and rest breaks under applicable state law. While occasional overtime may be needed, you'll always be compensated fairly for your time and effort.

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. The US base salary for this non-exempt position ranges from $19.23–$24.04 per hour (approximately $40,000 - $50,000, annually), depending on location and experience. Consistent with applicable laws, an employee's pay within this range is based on a number of factors, which include but are not limited to relevant education, skills, job-related knowledge, qualifications, work experience, credentials, and/or geographic location. Your recruiter can share more on target salary for your location during the interview process. Coalition, Inc. reserves the right to modify this range as needed.

Perks

  • 100% medical, dental and vision coverage
  • Flexible PTO policy
  • Annual home office stipend and WeWork access
  • Mental & physical health wellness programs (One Medical, Headspace, Wellhub, and more)!
  • Competitive compensation and opportunity for advancement

Why Coalition?

Work at Coalition is centered on the joint mission to Protect the Unprotected. We have built a remote-first, highly inclusive culture that welcomes people from diverse backgrounds. We trust each other to take responsibility, share ownership of outcomes, and put in the work together to protect businesses from digital risk. Coalition’s exceptional growth stems from its ability to address real-world problems for organizations of all sizes while remaining true to our founding values of character, humility, responsibility, purpose, authenticity, and inclusion.

We’re always looking for collaborative, inquisitive individuals to join #OurCoalition.

Visit our Newsroom >

Privacy Notice

Coalition is committed to protecting your privacy and handling your personal information responsibly. We collect, use, and store personal information as necessary for the recruitment process and in compliance with applicable privacy laws and regulations in all regions where we operate. We want you to understand what personal information we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding access, correction, and deletion of your data where applicable. Information submitted, collected, and processed as part of your application is subject to Coalition's Privacy Policy. For further details, please review our full Privacy Policy or contact us with any questions regarding how your information is handled.

Our Privacy Policy >

Safe Hiring Notice

All legitimate communication from Coalition comes from @coalitioninc.com emails, and open roles are listed only on our Careers page. We never ask for payment, banking details, or personal identification before an offer is accepted through our secure systems. If you believe you’ve been a victim of fraudulent recruiting, follow guidance from the Federal Trade Commission (FTC).

Anti-Discrimination Notice

Coalition is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Our policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all individuals, without discrimination or harassment on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable laws in each country where we operate. This commitment includes, but is not limited to, ensuring equal treatment in recruitment, selection, training, promotion, transfer, compensation, and all other aspects of employment. Coalition does not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, and we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace.

Accommodations

Coalition is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, including applicants and employees, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations in each country where we operate. Our policy is to support equal opportunity in the hiring process by considering qualified applicants regardless of disability or other protected characteristics, unless providing accommodation would impose an undue hardship or disproportionate burden. If you require accommodation to complete an application, interview, pre-employment testing, or participate in the selection process, please contact us at . We also consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in line with applicable laws and regulations in each jurisdiction.

To all recruitment agencies: Coalition does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our email alias, employees, or other physical or virtual organization locations. Coalition is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

raw.description:
Director, Regulatory Response and Examination Management

BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF SUNSTRONG MANAGEMENT
SunStrong Management is a leading independent asset management and servicing platform specializing in residential and commercial solar energy portfolios. SunStrong provides end-to-end services including operations and maintenance, customer billing and support, asset performance management, and investor reporting. The company partners with leading capital providers to optimize clean energy assets at scale, supporting the growth of distributed renewable energy while delivering reliable performance and exceptional customer experience. This is a remote position.


THE DIRECTOR, REGULATORY RESPONSE AND EXAMINATION MANAGEMENT POSITION

SunStrong Management is building out its regulatory response and examination management function to support a growing national portfolio. This role owns it.
SunStrong Management operates across a national footprint, which means a continuous flow of inquiries, examinations, and information requests from state regulators, federal agencies, investors, and quasi-governmental entities. Each arrives with its own scope, requirements, and timeline.
The Director of Regulatory Response and Examination Management designs that function and runs it. This is an opportunity to shape a regulatory response operation at real scale, with executive visibility and the authority to set how it works.
The person in this seat is accountable for driving matters to resolution, not for reporting status. Success is measured by items closed, deadlines met without escalation, and a process that holds up under examination.

Position Summary
The Director, Regulatory Response and Examination Management leads the organization's response to regulatory inquiries, audits, examinations, and enforcement matters affecting its solar asset management operations and underlying project portfolios. This role serves as the primary point of coordination between the company, its regulators, and internal stakeholders during examinations conducted by state public utility commissions, FERC, ISOs/RTOs, tax authorities, environmental agencies, and investor/lender compliance reviews. The Director builds and manages the frameworks, processes, and teams needed to respond accurately, efficiently, and defensibly to regulatory requests while minimizing operational and financial risk.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Regulatory Examination & Inquiry Management
  • Serve as the primary organizational lead for managing regulatory examinations, audits, inquiries, subpoenas, and data requests from federal and state regulators (e.g., FERC, state PUCs, ISOs/RTOs, IRS/tax equity auditors, and environmental agencies).
  • Develop and execute examination response plans, including timelines, document production strategy, subject-matter expert coordination, and escalation protocols.
  • Serve as a liaison with regulators and outside counsel, ensuring consistent, accurate, and timely communication throughout examinations.
  • Track examination status, findings, and required remediation across the solar asset portfolio, maintaining a centralized examination log for leadership and board reporting.
Response Coordination & Documentation
  • Coordinate cross-functionally with Legal, Asset Management, Engineering, Finance, and Operations teams to gather, validate, and produce accurate data and documentation in response to regulatory requests.
  • Draft and review formal regulatory responses, data requests, and correspondence, ensuring alignment with legal strategy and factual accuracy.
  • Maintain document management protocols and privilege logs to support examination readiness and defensible response practices.
Regulatory Risk & Compliance Program Development
  • Build and maintain a regulatory examination readiness program, including mock audits, response playbooks, and staff training on examination protocols.
  • Monitor evolving regulatory requirements affecting solar generation assets, interconnection compliance, RPS/REC programs, tax equity structures, and market participation rules; assess impact on the portfolio.
  • Partner with Compliance and Risk teams to identify examination trends and root causes, driving corrective action and process improvements.
  • Support development of policies, procedures, and internal controls that reduce regulatory risk exposure across the asset portfolio.

Stakeholder & Leadership Engagement
  • Prepare executive and board-level briefings summarizing examination status, findings, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Advise senior leadership on regulatory risk implications for acquisitions, financing, and portfolio transactions.
  • Manage and mentor a team of regulatory analysts/specialists, building examination management capability and bench strength.
  • Engage with external counsel, consultants, and industry associations on regulatory strategy and emerging examination trends.


REQUIREMENTS
  • 10+ years of experience managing relationships with and responses to third-party regulators and investors, including state regulatory agencies, federal agencies, examination bodies, and institutional investors or capital partners
  • Demonstrated experience running multi-jurisdiction regulatory response or examination programs, including concurrent matters with independent scopes and deadlines
  • Experience designing, improving, and scaling regulatory response processes, not solely operating within an established one
  • Experience managing document collection and production at volume, including coordination across multiple source systems and business units
  • Proven ability to drive cross-functional accountability without direct authority over the people doing the work
  • Strong written work product, including the ability to prepare first drafts suitable for legal and compliance review
  • Sound judgment handling confidential, privileged, and sensitive material

Preferred
  • Background in mortgage servicing, consumer finance, solar finance, or another heavily regulated consumer-facing industry
  • Experience with state licensing examinations and audit readiness
  • Familiarity with formal information request and subpoena response mechanics
  • Experience managing outside counsel relationships and external legal spending
  • JD is not required for this role



physical requirements
  • Extended period working at a computer workstation

Benefits

SunStrong Management offers a rich and affordable benefits package through UnitedHealthcare and MetLife within the US intercontinental states. Our benefits include:
  • HDHP and PPO Medical Plans, buy-up plans for both Dental and Vision, ancillaries such as Accident, Critical illness, Hospital indemnity, Short term and Long-Term Disability, Voluntary Life, and legal services along with multiple add-ons.
  • Our 401(k) Package includes an Employer Match of 100% up to the first 4% and 50% on the next 2% with immediate vesting.

Job Title: Senior SAP MII Developer – Fixed Term
Job Code: L6442
FLSA Status: Exempt
Grade: 19
Recruiting Firm: Symbiotic Services

Revised: 11/18/2025

Job Summary

Symbiotic Services is seeking a highly skilled Senior SAP MII Developer for a fixed-term opportunity. This role will lead the analysis, design, and development of SAP MII integrations across SAP S/4HANA, Blue Yonder, and various manufacturing applications. You will be a key contributor to a strategic initiative focused on implementing global SAP S/4HANA and Blue Yonder platforms for the U.S. market and manufacturing operations across the Americas.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain SAP MII solutions to integrate SAP ECC with manufacturing systems (MES, EMS, WMS)
  • Collaborate with manufacturing, IT, and business teams to gather requirements and deliver integration solutions
  • Review development work of other MII developers for consistency and quality
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to data flow, connectivity, and system performance
  • Support and enhance existing MII integrations and interfaces
  • Ensure data integrity and consistency across integrated platforms
  • Document technical specifications, integration flows, and support procedures
  • Work with internal teams and external partners to align applications with global standards and strategy
  • Partner with Business Process Leads, IT Tower Leads, and Global IT teams including Enterprise Architecture and Solutions Delivery

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on SAP MII development (10+ years preferred)
  • Proven experience integrating SAP ECC with MES, EMS, and WMS systems
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and shop floor systems
  • Proficient in XML, SQL, and web technologies used in MII
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • 10+ years of SAP MII development experience
  • SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA upgrade experience or similar complex projects
  • Familiarity with MES, historian, production orders, and batch management
  • Experience in global delivery environments and governance models
  • Experience integrating applications with SAP S/4 using SAP BTP

Work Environment & Physical Demands

  • Light physical effort; may occasionally lift or move objects under 10 lbs.
  • Prolonged periods of sitting, standing, or walking
  • Manual dexterity and fine motor skills required
  • Frequent computer and keyboard use

raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

The Samsara Data Platform team owns and develops the analytic platform across Samsara. As a Manager II of Data Platform, you will build and lead teams that maintain our data lake and surrounding infrastructure. You will also be responsible for meeting new business needs, including expanding the platform as the company grows (both in size and geographic coverage), privacy and security needs, and customer-facing feature developments.

This role is open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You want to build for scale: With over 2.3 million IoT devices deployed to our global customers, you will work on a range of new and mature technologies driving scalable innovation for customers across industries driving the world's physical operations.
  • You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
  • You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
  • You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we’re all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win—together.

Click here to learn about what we value at Samsara.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead a team of data-focused engineers to build and maintain a stable, scalable, and modern data platform capable of handling petabytes of data.
  • Help drive long-term planning and establish scalable processes for execution.
  • Actively contribute to building the data roadmap for Samsara, including being a thought leader in our AI transformation.
  • Stay connected to novel technological developments that suit Samsara’s needs.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high-performing international team.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science or other related technical degree.
  • 2+ years of technical people management experience.
  • 5+ years of relevant technical experience with data infrastructure.
  • Experience building and deploying large-scale data platform systems with feedback loops for continuous improvement.
  • Comfortable leading infrastructure development in collaboration with cross functional teams, scientists, and researchers.
  • A solid understanding of agentic development practices.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • MS or PhD in Computer Science or other technical degree.
  • Experience with state-of-art data platform technologies such as:
    • AWS (S3 and RDS, SQS, DMS, Dynamo, etc.).
    • Spark a must, Flink, Trino/Presto a plus.
    • Data lake file formats such as Delta, Hudi, or Iceberg.
    • Python/Scala.
    • Container based orchestration services such as Kubernetes, ECS, Fargate, etc.
    • Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g., Terraform).
    • Go is a plus.
    • Data orchestration system experience is a plus (e.g., Airflow, Dagster).
  • Proven track record for innovation and delivering value to customers (both internal and external).
  • Demonstrated ability to build cross-functional consensus and drive cross-team collaboration.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$154,700—$234,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

This is a remote position.

Strategy & Transformation PMO Analyst
Location: Virtual-first (EMEA-based) | Remote position with travel requirements varying by engagement, up to 50% to client sites in your region. Hiring regionally to serve a global customer base, with priority given to candidates in the Americas and EMEA.
Type: Full-time or Contract-to-Hire

About Global Transformation Group

Global Transformation Group is the consulting sister organization of PMO Strategies, creators of the IMPACT Engine System™ and host of the PMO Strategies Podcast. With shared ownership, the two organizations operate collaboratively—ensuring our teams have access to the best training, tools, and resources to deliver high-IMPACT outcomes for our clients and students.

At Global Transformation Group, we turn vision into value. Our mission is to help forward-thinking organizations close the gap between strategy design and execution using the IMPACT Engine System™—a proven transformation framework that builds internal capability, accelerates performance, and delivers measurable business outcomes.

We help organizations accelerate strategy delivery by operating at the intersection of strategy, operations, and change. From ambitious mid-sized companies to global enterprises, we enable clients to organize, operate, and deliver differently—so they can lead with greater agility, clarity, and confidence.

About the Role

We’re looking for a PMO Analyst—a sharp, detail-oriented professional with strong analytical and coordination skills who thrives on creating order from complexity. In this role, you’ll support the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of enterprise project management and transformation practices across client engagements.

This is a role for someone who loves connecting the dots—between strategy and execution, data and decisions, people and process. You’ll work closely with senior consultants and client teams to provide analysis, insights, and structure that enable high-IMPACT delivery across portfolios, programs, and projects.

What You’ll Do

PMO & Portfolio Analysis

  • Gather, analyze, and interpret portfolio and program data to provide actionable insights for decision-making.

  • Support portfolio prioritization, planning, and governance activities, ensuring alignment to strategic goals.

  • Develop dashboards, reports, and presentations that clearly communicate progress, risks, and opportunities.

  • Track benefits realization and ensure project outcomes are tied to measurable business impact.

Project & Process Support

  • Coordinate and track key milestones, deliverables, and interdependencies across initiatives.

  • Assist in developing and maintaining PMO frameworks, templates, and processes aligned with the IMPACT Engine System™.

  • Support project scheduling, resource management, and reporting to ensure accuracy and visibility.

  • Identify process gaps and recommend improvements that increase efficiency and consistency across programs.

Change & Communication Enablement

  • Support change and stakeholder management efforts, ensuring that messages, timelines, and impacts are clearly communicated.

  • Partner with transformation leads to ensure project and portfolio updates are timely, accurate, and aligned with organizational priorities.

  • Help create artifacts, playbooks, and tools that reinforce alignment and adoption across stakeholder groups.

Continuous Improvement & Knowledge Management

  • Participate in project retrospectives, capturing lessons learned and improvement opportunities.

  • Maintain PMO repositories and knowledge bases, ensuring information is current, consistent, and accessible.

  • Contribute to internal GTG innovation efforts by refining templates, tools, and methodologies used across client engagements.

What You Bring

  • 3–6+ years of experience in project management, PMO, or portfolio management support—consulting experience a plus.

  • Strong analytical skills with experience in data visualization, metrics tracking, and portfolio reporting.

  • Proficiency with project and portfolio management tools (e.g., Planview, Smartsheet, Asana, Monday, Power BI).

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to simplify complex information for executive audiences.

  • Solid understanding of project delivery lifecycles (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid).

  • Ability to balance attention to detail with a broader understanding of strategic priorities.

  • PMP, CAPM, or equivalent certification preferred.

  • IMPACT Engine System™ Certification preferred (support provided if not already certified).

Ideal Candidate
You’re a curious problem-solver with a passion for structure, insights, and clarity. You bring both analytical rigor and people skills to the table—comfortable working with data but equally effective communicating its meaning. You thrive in fast-moving environments and enjoy helping teams perform at their best through thoughtful organization and insight.

We operate like a start-up inside a mature consulting firm: high trust, low politics, and obsessed with impact. If you want autonomy, collaboration, and a platform to grow your consulting and analytical career—this is your seat.

Why Join Us (Instead of a Big Firm)?

Think of us as what the big consulting companies could be—with soul.

  • You implement transformation, not just recommend it.
  • No armies of analysts, no layers of red tape. You work directly with executives and our leadership team.
  • You grow your own thought leadership, not just your billing hours.
  • You’ll help refine the system, not just follow one.
  • You’ll work on what matters. High-impact transformation. Strategic enablement. Long-term capability building.

Career Growth & Development
  • Advance quickly into more senior roles or client advisory positions as you demonstrate mastery.
  • Become a Strategy Navigator™, our highest-tier designation for advisors who shape strategy, not just delivery.
  • Participate in internal innovation and thought leadership, including speaking, writing, and contributing to new IES tools and approaches.
  • Access IES certification, advanced coaching, and mastermind communities to stay sharp and continually evolve your own leadership.

Engagement Model
  • Contract-to-hire: Initial consulting engagement with a strong path to a permanent leadership position.
  • Virtual-first work model, with travel to client locations as needed.
  • Compensation aligned with experience and engagement scope, with opportunities to grow.

How to Apply

To apply, please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining:

  • Why you're excited to join Global Transformation Group, PMO Strategies sister company
  • Relevant experience aligned with this role
  • Your availability and compensation expectations

We’re building something meaningful—and we’re looking for people who are ready to make an IMPACT.

Does this role feel wonderful but a bit intimidating? If you have some, but not all the experience, please submit anyway, as we are going to have multiple PMO and transformation delivery roles. You can also check out our other postings, such as the Project Manager role, that might be a closer fit.

raw.description:
Devoted Studios is a globally remote game development company specializing in Co-development, Porting, and End-to-End Art Production for the global gaming industry.

We collaborate across time zones to support projects on all major platforms, engines and styles - from AAA titles to emerging technologies. Our team includes world-class talents who bring deep expertise in external development, pipeline optimization, and creative problem-solving. Whether it’s porting games to new systems, enhancing gameplay features, or crafting stunning visuals, Devoted Studios operates as a trusted, flexible extension of our partners’ internal teams. We are proud to be the development partner of choice for industry leaders such as:

  • Epic
  • Xbox
  • Meta
  • Obsidian Entertainment
  • Riot
  • Gearbox Software

We're hiring a Business Development Director or Senior BD Manager who can do both halves of the job: source and close new business, and grow the accounts we already have. Reporting directly to the Head of BD, you'll be the operator who makes pipeline, retention, and account growth predictable. We are open to the seniority of the role depending on candidate experience.

This is not a hunter-handoff role. You'll stay close to your accounts after signing, partner with production when issues come up, and be the operator clients trust to tell them the truth.

It's also not a relationship-manager role. You'll have a personal lead-generation pipeline and you'll be measured on new logos sourced as well as existing accounts grown. We need both motions in one operator.

Key Responsibilities:

New business and pipeline

• Identify and pursue new business opportunities, partnerships, and strategic alliances to expand Devoted's client base.

• Build your own lead-generation pipeline — outbound, network, events — alongside developing existing relationships.

• Run the full deal cycle: discovery, scoping with production, proposal, negotiation, and close.

• Collaborate with the production team to identify and shape opportunities that play to Devoted's capabilities and expertise.

Account growth and retention

• Maintain client satisfaction at 8/10 or higher across your portfolio of clients

• Build and nurture strong relationships with clients at every level — operational, senior, and strategic.

• Support the Head of BD with account retention and management strategies for the largest accounts.

• Continuously assess and evaluate the effectiveness of business development strategies and initiatives, recommending improvements and adjustments as needed.

Client liaison and contract

• Be the client's primary point of contact when production issues come up — ensuring both parties focus on finding the best solution rather than placing blame.

• Negotiate and finalize contracts and agreements with clients, partners, and vendors to ensure favorable terms and mutually beneficial relationships.

• Support legal and finance with any questions on contracts and invoicing for current accounts.

Operating discipline

• Be an evangelist of CRM excellence: prepare weekly plans and report on current and prospective client communication.

• Prepare regular status reports including activity, closings, follow-up, and adherence to goals.

• Participate in networking events, conferences, and industry shows — represent Devoted, bring back leads and intelligence.

Requirements

• 7+ years in business development, sales, or partnerships in the games industry, with a track record of revenue ownership at the Director level.

• Platform-agnostic experience — you've sold or grown accounts across PC, console, and mobile. Not a single-platform specialist.

• Demonstrable personal lead generation: you've built outbound discipline and converted at the top of the funnel, not just managed inbound.

• Account growth track record: existing accounts that grew quarter-over-quarter under your ownership, with measurable numbers behind it.

• Real contract negotiation experience on commercial terms — pricing, scope, IP, payment terms, indemnity.

• Strong commercial fluency: you understand margin, you know what a scope change costs, and you can read a project P&L.

• CRM discipline: HubSpot, Salesforce, or comparable — used as an operating tool, not a reporting chore.

• Outstanding relationship management and interpersonal skills — caring team player who engages effectively across all levels of management, staff, and clients.

• Excellent presentation, written, and spoken English — comfortable in front of senior client stakeholders and on stage at industry events.

• Strong analytical and project management skills — able to juggle multiple deals and accounts, prioritize ruthlessly, and meet tight deadlines without losing the detail.

• Genuine knowledge of and passion for video games and the broader games ecosystem — engines, platforms, business models, who's hot and who's fading.

• Calm under pressure, organized, accountable. World-class quality is the only acceptable standard.

Nice to Have

• Experience selling co-development, porting, art services, or other game services (vs. only IP licensing or publishing).

• Existing personal network across publishers, platform holders, and mid-to-large independent studios in North America and Europe.

• Experience hiring and mentoring junior BD or lead-gen staff.

• Conference circuit familiarity: GDC, Gamescom, Devcom, regional summits.

• Familiarity with advanced research tools and resources for prospecting and intelligence.

Benefits

  • 26 days leave throughout the year (accrued with tenure and company downtime during holiday periods)
  • Interesting and challenging tasks – solve diverse and challenging issues, communicate with people within the company as well as with our partners;
  • Convenient working conditions – remote work, the opportunity to build your own working day with flexible working hours
  • А chance to work in a highly professional and dynamic team working with a wide range of International Game Production projects, attractive remuneration package, and opportunities to develop professionally.

This is a remote, full-time contracted position.

We are an equal opportunity company and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contract without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

• 2 years of experience with FHIR APIs

• Minimum requirements plus

Travel Required:

Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 5 – 8 years of related experience.

About the Role

At Pavago, we’re hiring on behalf of one of our clients for an AIA Billing Specialist to manage contracts, AIA billing, construction bonding, and project documentation for a growing commercial construction company.

This is a specialized construction operations role—not a general administrative position.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • AIA billing (G702/G703)
  • Schedule of Values (SOV) management
  • Construction contracts
  • Bonding coordination
  • Project documentation
  • Billing compliance

We’re looking for someone who has supported U.S.-based commercial construction projects remotely and has hands-on experience managing payment applications, retainage, contract administration, and bonding requirements.

If you thrive in structured, deadline-driven construction environments and enjoy keeping projects financially organized, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

AIA Billing & Project Administration

  • Prepare and submit AIA billing packages using:
    • G702
    • G703
  • Maintain and update Schedule of Values (SOV) across active projects.
  • Track:
    • Retainage
    • Payment milestones
    • Billing status
  • Ensure all billing submissions are accurate and submitted on time.
  • Identify billing discrepancies before they impact project cash flow.

Contracts & Bonding

  • Manage commercial construction contracts throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Coordinate:
    • Bid bonds
    • Performance bonds
    • Maintenance bonds
  • Prepare and submit bonding documentation.
  • Communicate with:
    • Bonding companies
    • Municipalities
    • General contractors
  • Ensure compliance with contractual requirements and deadlines.

Project Documentation & Systems

  • Maintain project documentation within:
    • Buildertrend
    • or similar construction management software
  • Keep project records:
    • Organized
    • Accurate
    • Audit-ready
  • Maintain CRM and project management data integrity.
  • Support project reporting and operational visibility.

Administrative & Operational Support

  • Coordinate communication with:
    • Clients
    • Contractors
    • Vendors
    • Project stakeholders
  • Support pre-construction administrative activities.
  • Organize:
    • Contracts
    • Permits
    • Project files
    • Supporting documentation
  • Participate in weekly project meetings and provide project status updates.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Prior remote experience supporting a U.S.-based general contractor or commercial construction company.
  • Proven experience with:
    • AIA Billing
    • G702/G703 payment applications
    • Schedule of Values (SOV)
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Bid bonds
    • Performance bonds
    • Maintenance bonds
  • Experience tracking retainage and construction billing documentation.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Exceptional organizational and multitasking abilities.
  • High attention to detail and accuracy.

Nice to Have

  • Experience using:
    • Buildertrend
    • or similar construction management software
  • Background in:
    • Commercial construction
    • Landscaping
    • Trades-related industries
  • Basic construction accounting or bookkeeping experience.
  • Familiarity with:
    • Construction financial reporting
    • Payment tracking
    • CRM systems
    • Project tracking platforms

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You have hands-on commercial construction administration experience.
  • You understand AIA billing and construction payment processes.
  • You thrive in deadline-driven environments.
  • You proactively identify issues before they delay projects.
  • You manage multiple active projects without sacrificing accuracy.
  • You work independently with minimal supervision.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review upcoming AIA billing deadlines.
  • Prepare G702/G703 payment applications.
  • Update Schedule of Values documentation.
  • Monitor retainage and project payment status.
  • Coordinate with bonding companies and contractors.
  • Update Buildertrend and project records.
  • Review contracts and compliance documentation.
  • Prepare reports and project updates for leadership.

In short: You ensure commercial construction projects remain financially organized, contractually compliant, and operationally on track from billing through project completion.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Accuracy and timeliness of AIA billing submissions
  • On-time completion of bonding documentation
  • Accuracy of project records and CRM data
  • Reduction in billing delays and payment issues
  • Compliance with contract and documentation requirements

Why Join Us?

  • High-impact role supporting commercial construction operations.
  • Strong ownership across billing, contracts, and project administration.

  • Career progression into:
    • Construction Operations Manager
    • Project Administrator
    • Billing Manager
    • Contracts Manager

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Client Interview
  3. Offer Stage

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps hiring managers evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful and reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

You will join a cross-functional team responsible for developing and operating a distributed ecosystem of backend services and integrations.

Your responsibilities

- Own backend services throughout their lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, operation, and continuous improvement.
- Translate product and business requirements into maintainable technical designs, clearly communicating risks and trade-offs to Product Owners, architects, and other engineering teams.
- Design and implement secure, versioned REST APIs and maintain their OpenAPI contracts.
- Develop primarily with Node.js and TypeScript, using PostgreSQL/PostGIS for relational and geospatial data.
- Design database schemas, transactions, indexes, and backward-compatible migrations; analyze and optimize complex SQL queries.
- Build reliable integrations with Kafka, AWS S3, GeoServer, and internal or external APIs.
- Implement automated unit and integration tests and contribute to API-contract, end-to-end, and performance testing.
- Build observability into services through structured logging, metrics, tracing, health checks, and actionable
alerting.
- Diagnose defects and production incidents, participate in root-cause analysis, and implement preventive
improvements.
- Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and operate containerized services on OpenShift/Kubernetes.
- Review merge requests, mentor engineers, and promote pragmatic engineering and quality standards.
- Maintain API documentation, architectural decisions, and operational runbooks.
- Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly, retaining full accountability for the correctness, security, privacy, and maintainability of delivered code.

Required experience
- Strong professional experience with Node.js and TypeScript, including asynchronous programming, production debugging, and type-safe application design.
- Strong SQL and PostgreSQL skills, including data modeling, transactions, indexing, query-plan analysis, and connection pooling.
- Experience designing and maintaining RESTful APIs and OpenAPI specifications.
- Experience with automated backend testing using Jest or Vitest and tools such as Supertest.
- Practical understanding of distributed systems and microservice design, including failure handling, idempotency, and backward-compatible interfaces.
- Experience with authentication, authorization, input validation, and secure backend development.
- Experience operating production services, including monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident analysis.
- Ability to lead technical discussions, communicate trade-offs, review code constructively, and mentor colleagues.
- Professional working proficiency in English.

Valuable additional experience
- PostGIS, GeoJSON, coordinate reference systems, or other geospatial technologies.
- Kafka and event-driven architecture.
- AWS S3 and secure object-storage patterns.
- Docker and OpenShift/Kubernetes.
- Knex.js or comparable SQL query and migration tooling.
- OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or structured logging platforms.
- NGINX and API gateway or reverse-proxy configuration.
- Python services or data-processing workflows.
- GitLab CI/CD, API linting, container security scanning, and automated release pipelines.

raw.description:
Location: Atlanta, GA / Remote

Department: Legal

Reports to: Assistant General Counsel – Privacy, AI, and Data Governance

Why Join Omnicell?

Omnicell is building its enterprise data governance program and we are looking for a Manager, Data Governance to join our Legal Department and help define how data is managed, trusted, and used across the company.

You will develop the standards and policies that govern how data is managed across its lifecycle, establish a data use program with clear quality standards, and design a de-identification program that complies with HIPAA requirements to enable responsible analytics and research. This role turns governance requirements into practical, adoptable processes and controls, so that data across Omnicell is accurate, trusted, and used in accordance with applicable law and internal policy.

What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

As a Manager, Data Governance, you will:

  • Primary Impact – Make data across Omnicell accurate, trusted, and used in accordance with applicable law and internal policy, so that business, analytics, and research teams can move quickly on a foundation they can rely on.
  • Standards and policy – Develop, implement, and maintain Omnicell’s data governance standards, policies, and procedures across the data lifecycle, aligned with business objectives and applicable regulatory requirements
  • Operational adoption – Translate governance requirements into practical processes and controls that operational teams can readily adopt
  • Data use program – Establish a formal data use program that defines how data may be accessed, used, and shared, with clear quality standards, approval workflows, and accountability
  • Data quality management – Define, monitor, and report on data quality standards, metrics, and KPIs — such as accuracy, completeness, and consistency — and partner with data owners and stewards to identify root causes and drive remediation
  • HIPAA de-identification – Design and operate a de-identification program that complies with HIPAA requirements, including the Safe Harbor and Expert Determination methods, to enable de-identified analytics and research while protecting PHI
  • Ownership and stewardship – Define data ownership and stewardship models, assigning clear roles and responsibilities across business and technical teams
  • Governance artifacts – Establish and maintain governance artifacts and documentation, including policies, standards, a business glossary, data dictionaries, metadata, and data lineage
  • Risk assessment and remediation – Conduct data risk assessments and manage remediation plans for data quality, governance, and compliance issues
  • Cross-functional alignment – Partner with Privacy, Legal, Enterprise Security, Quality, and IT to align data practices with applicable law and contractual obligations
  • Reporting and continuous improvement – Provide regular reporting on data quality, policy adoption, and exceptions to data and privacy leadership, and drive continuous improvement through training, process change, and escalation
  • Data literacy and stewardship culture – Foster a culture of data stewardship and data literacy through guidance, enablement, and training across the organization

Who You Are (Qualifications & Skills)

Minimum Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in data governance, data management, or a related discipline
  • Proven experience developing and implementing data governance frameworks, policies, and standards
  • Experience establishing or operating data quality standards, metrics, and monitoring mechanisms
  • Strong command of data governance principles, frameworks, and best practices, such as DAMA-DMBOK
  • Practical knowledge of data quality concepts, metadata management, and data lineage principles
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA de-identification standards, including the Safe Harbor and Expert Determination methods
  • Familiarity with HIPAA/HITECH, CCPA/CPRA, and how they shape data use, data sharing, and governance
  • The ability to translate governance requirements into practical, adoptable processes and controls
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior and cross-functional teams without direct authority
  • An analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret data models and use basic querying to validate governance outcomes
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear governance documentation
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to set priorities and manage competing demands, and a collaborative, solutions-oriented approach with sharp attention to detail

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in information management, data management, computer science, business administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • Advanced degree or relevant certification, such as CDMP, CIPP/US, CIPM, or CHPC
  • Experience in healthcare, medical device, or another HIPAA-regulated environment
  • Hands-on experience designing or operating a HIPAA de-identification program, including Expert Determination
  • Experience supporting de-identified analytics, research data environments, or a governed data lake
  • Familiarity with data governance and catalog tooling, such as Collibra, Alation, Informatica, or Securiti
  • Experience supporting global or cross-regional data programs, including GDPR

Work Conditions

  • Flexibility in working hours as needed
  • Some travel, ~10%

Description

For many of us there’s that one podcast we never miss, and video content is part of our daily routine, whether it’s professional or personal. But how many of us truly understand the effort that goes on behind the scenes? Here at Riverside, we know it well. That’s exactly why we built an AI-powered platform that helps content creators, podcasters, marketeers, and more at major brands like Netflix, Disney, Google, and Microsoft to create high-quality content with ease.

Riverside’s technology streamlines the entire content creation process, turning ideas into professional-grade content with the highest production standards, without requiring expensive equipment or external services. The secret? AI-driven tools that replace traditional production roles like editing, directing, and design, automating the entire process at the click of a button.

About the Customer Success Team

Our Customer Success team is dedicated to helping our customers maximize the value of our platform. We build strong relationships, provide strategic guidance, and ensure a seamless experience from onboarding to renewal. Acting as trusted advisors, we proactively address challenges, drive adoption, and identify opportunities for growth. If you're passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences and thrive in a dynamic, relationship-focused role, this is the team for you.

﻿On your day-to-today

You will manage a portfolio of SMB customers, acting as a strategic partner and trusted advisor to help them unlock the full value of Riverside. Your focus will be on driving adoption, enabling success at scale, and ensuring long-term retention and growth. You’ll lead regular business reviews, guide high-impact conversations, and identify opportunities for renewals and expansion. As the voice of the customer, you'll collaborate cross-functionally with Product and Marketing to influence roadmap priorities and share best practices. Your ability to build deep relationships, think proactively, and consult on how Riverside fits into broader business goals will be key to your success.

Location: This is a remote role based in Mexico with a requirement to work Eastern time zone business hours.

Requirements

What you bring to the table:

  • At least 1 years of experience in customer success/ customer support in a SaaS environment.
  • Experience managing a high velocity of accounts
  • Desire to work remotely in a fast-paced startup environment
  • Passion to apply your tech-savviness to learn Riverside’s product functionality
  • An ability to excel in achieving KPIs and targets
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to prioritize, organize, and execute multiple tasks with deadlines

Join us at Riverside and be a part of our mission to empower creators and businesses to tell their stories and amplify their voices!

This is a remote position.

Position:Manager - M&E

Please note: We accept applications for this role year-round and recruit on a rolling, as-needed basis. If you apply, we'll keep your application on file and review it as opportunities arise. We'll get in touch if a suitable vacancy becomes available and your experience and skills are a good match for the role.
About 4th Wheel Social Impact

At 4th Wheel, we specialize in providing data-driven insights that help organizations create measurable social impact. Since 2010, we've worked with diverse partners to design, implement, and evaluate programs across multiple sectors, focusing on social development, capacity building, and communications for development.

Our Values

We are driven by teamwork, entrepreneurial mindsets, lifelong learning, constructive thinking, and empathetic leadership. These values guide us in creating meaningful change through collaborative, data-driven approaches.

About the Role

The Manager - Monitoring & Evaluation (M&E) will lead the strategic design, implementation, and management of M&E studies across multiple social impact projects. This senior leadership role involves managing teams of M&E professionals, establishing organizational M&E standards, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality evidence-based insights that drive meaningful social change. The Manager will be responsible for client relationship management, strategic planning, and building institutional capacity in monitoring and evaluation.


Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and manage a team of Sr. Executives, Executives, and Research Associates

  • Provide strategic direction for M&E activities across multiple projects and sectors

  • Mentor and develop junior staff, conducting performance evaluations and career development planning

  • Establish and maintain organizational M&E standards, protocols, and quality assurance frameworks

  • Coordinate with senior leadership on strategic planning and business development initiatives

M&E Framework Design & Implementation

  • Design and oversee the development of M&E frameworks and studies for social impact projects

  • Lead the creation of theories of change, logical frameworks, and results measurement systems

  • Establish organizational standards for data collection methodologies and quality assurance protocols

  • Oversee the development of qualitative and quantitative M&E tools, instruments, and digital data collection systems

  • Ensure alignment of M&E frameworks with donor requirements and international best practices

Research & Analysis Leadership

  • Lead comprehensive quantitative and qualitative research studies across multiple projects

  • Oversee complex data analysis using advanced statistical methods and research methodologies like Excel, SPSS, Dedoose, NVIVO, etc.

  • Guide teams in generating actionable insights and strategic recommendations from complex datasets

  • Establish data analysis protocols and ensure consistent application across all projects

Client Relationship Management & Business Development

  • Serve as primary point of contact for key clients and stakeholders on M&E matters

  • Lead proposal development and technical writing for M&E project leads

  • Present findings and recommendations to senior leadership of client organizations

  • Facilitate high-level stakeholder meetings and strategic planning sessions

  • Identify opportunities for expanding M&E services and building long-term client partnerships

Report Writing & Knowledge Management

  • Lead the preparation of visual appealing and data focused evaluation reports, research studies, and policy briefs

  • Ensure all reports meet international standards for evaluation and research documentation

  • Oversee the development of knowledge products, case studies, and thought leadership materials

  • Establish organizational knowledge management systems and best practice documentation

Capacity Building & Training

  • Design and deliver training programs on M&E methodologies for internal teams and external partners

  • Develop organizational capacity in emerging M&E approaches and technologies

  • Lead workshops and capacity building sessions for client organizations

  • Contribute to the development of M&E training curricula and materials

  • Represent the organization at conferences, workshops, and professional forums

Required Skills & Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Master's degree or PhD in Development Studies, Statistics, Economics, Social Work, or related field

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in research roles within development sector/NGOs/research organizations

  • Minimum 4 years of experience specifically in Monitoring & Evaluation roles

  • Proven experience in managing teams and leading complex projects

Technical Skills

Must be proficient in at least one of the following:

  • Quantitative Tools:SPSS, R, Stata or Advanced Excel

  • Qualitative Tools:Dedoose, NVivo, or Atlas.ti

Core Competencies

  • Exceptional written English skills with proven ability to produce high-quality research reports

  • Strong knowledge of both qualitative and quantitative research methodologies

  • Experience in developing M&E frameworks, logical frameworks, and theory of change models

  • Proven ability to design and oversee implementation of data collection tools and survey instruments

  • Demonstrated experience in leading and managing teams of M&E professionals

  • Excellent presentation and facilitation skills with ability to communicate with senior stakeholders

  • Strong project management capabilities with experience managing multiple projects simultaneously

  • Experience with mobile data collection platforms (SurveyCTO, KoBo Toolbox, etc.)

  • Strong analytical thinking and strategic problem-solving capabilities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with social development programs in education, health, livelihoods, or governance

  • Familiarity with participatory evaluation methods and community-based research approaches

  • Knowledge of donor requirements and international evaluation standards (OECD-DAC, SROI, etc.)

  • Experience in proposal writing and business development activities

  • Publication record in peer-reviewed journals or policy publications

Personal Attributes

  • Collaboration:Working together with trust, empathy, and shared commitment to impact across diverse teams and cultural backgrounds
  • Transparency:Responsibility for work and decisions, holding oneself accountable to the people and purpose we serve
  • Growth:Commitment to continuously reading, reflecting, and deepening knowledge in M&E methodologies and practices
  • Empathy:Balancing empathy with accountability and maintaining a deep sense of responsibility for others
  • Leadership:Strong leadership and team management capabilities
