raw.excerpt: Das ist dein Job bei unsIm wöchentlichen Check-in siehst du, dass drei Projekte für das Quartal seit zwei Wochen stillstehen.
raw.description:
Das ist dein Job bei uns

Im wöchentlichen Check-in siehst du, dass drei Projekte für das Quartal seit zwei Wochen stillstehen. Niemand hat den Status und den Fortschritt aktualisiert. Du fragst nicht nach dem Status. Du schaust in den Prozess dahinter.

Du gehst den Ablauf mit dem Teamlead durch. Die Zahlen für das Projekt liegen in drei Tools. Jemand muss sie jeden Montag von Hand zusammentragen. Also passiert es nicht.

Du baust den Ablauf neu. In ClickUp entsteht ein Workflow mit klaren Verantwortlichen und Fristen. Die Zahlen laufen über Make automatisch in ein Dashboard. Das baust du mit Ali und Arthur aus unserem Prozess-Team. Die SOP dazu schreibst du selbst.

Im Reporting an Lukas aus der Geschäftsführung liegt der Zielfortschritt jetzt jede Woche auf dem Tisch und das Team arbeitet deutlich effizienter.

Einen Tag später nimmst du dir den nächsten Bottleneck vor. Nicht, weil sich jemand beschwert, sondern weil dir ineffiziente Prozesse ins Auge springen. Du schaffst dem ganzen Team Freiräume.

Wofür wir arbeiten

Wir wollen der stärkste ganzheitliche Wachstumspartner für E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Raum sein.

Denn was wir immer wieder sehen: Agenturen und Dienstleister betreuen Brands nischig und siloartig, Kanal für Kanal, ohne Blick aufs Ganze. Dabei bleiben enorme Potenziale auf der Strecke.

Wir verstehen uns deshalb nicht als Dienstleister, sondern als Teil des Unternehmens unserer Kunden. Dafür arbeiten bei EVOLVE 30 Spezialisten in sechs Fachbereichen zusammen, vollständig remote und seit dem ersten Tag.

Was dich hier erwartet

Du baust nicht nur die Prozesse im Hintergrund. Du sorgst im Alltag dafür, dass unser Unternehmen und das gesamte Team reibungsloser funktionieren: Deadlines werden eingehalten, Aufgaben abgeschlossen, Projekte kommen voran.

Denn die besten Prozesse bringen nichts, wenn niemand nachhält, ob sie greifen. Genau das ist deine Aufgabe.

Was das im Alltag heißt:

  • Du übersetzt die Jahres- und Quartalsziele in konkrete Maßnahmen, Meilensteine und Checklisten. So bleibt die Strategie im Alltag greifbar.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass das EVOLVE OS als ganzheitliches System und Kern unserer Dienstleistung funktioniert und sich fortlaufend weiterentwickelt

  • Du steuerst die operativen Abläufe vor allem innerhalb der Agentur und bei Bedarf zusätzlich in Finance und People Ops, von Rechnungswesen über Onboarding.

  • Du entwickelst KPI-Dashboards und Übersichten, wo sie benötigt und sinnvoll sind.

  • Du führst neue Automationen und Prozesse über Claude, Make und n8n ein. Für die Umsetzung stellen wir dir ein Team zur Verfügung.

  • Du betreibst das OKR-System im Alltag: Reminder, Check-ins, Dashboards. Ziele, die niemand nachhält, bleiben.

  • Zusammen mit den Teamleads gehst du Bottlenecks im Tagesgeschäft durch und löst sie an der Wurzel, nicht mit einem Pflaster.

Der letzte Punkt ist uns wichtig. Diese Rolle gibt es bei uns nur einmal, deshalb bist du die Schnittstelle zwischen allen sechs Fachbereichen, nicht nur zu einem Team.

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projekt- und Prozessmanagement, idealerweise im Agentur- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld.

  • Du kennst dich mit Projektmanagement-Tools wie ClickUp oder Asana aus und verstehst in den Grundzügen Automation-Tools wie Make oder n8n.

  • Analytisches und systemisches Denken mit Controlling-Grundlagen. Du siehst nicht nur die Kennzahl, sondern auch, was dahinter steckt.

  • Sehr gute Selbstorganisation, da wir 100 % remote arbeiten.

  • Klare, strukturierte Kommunikation nach innen und außen. Du arbeitest mit Team Leads auf Augenhöhe an ihren Prozessen, ohne sie disziplinarisch zu führen.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Google-Tabellen und Excel für Auswertungen und Datenstrukturen.

  • Hohe Affinität für AI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude und Co. Du nutzt sie, um Systeme zu bauen und Probleme zu lösen, nicht nur ,um Texte zu erstellen.

Direkt gesagt: Dieser Job passt nicht zu jedem

Du solltest dich nicht bewerben, wenn dir das Tagesgeschäft zu kleinteilig ist. Diese Rolle lebt von Prozessen und Details, nicht von reiner Strategiearbeit.

Du bist bei uns auch nicht richtig, wenn dir Prozessmanagement noch komplett fremd ist. Genau diese Erfahrung macht hier den Unterschied.

Der Rahmen

  • Klare Entwicklungsperspektive Richtung Head of Operations

  • 100 % Remote seit Tag 1, kein Hybrid-Kompromiss

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Jobrad und Firmenfitness über Wellpass

  • Laptop deiner Wahl und hochwertige Homeoffice-Ausstattung

  • Weiterbildungsbudget sowie Unterstützung durch interne und externe Quellen und Mentoren an deiner Seite

  • Voller Zugriff auf unseren internen AI-Stack

  • Zweimal jährlich Teamevents und Workations

So läuft der Prozess

Deine Bewerbung. Dein Lebenslauf reicht. Wenn wir Rückfragen haben, schicken wir dir einen kurzen Fragebogen.

Erstgespräch. Ein kurzes Video-Gespräch mit Vanessa aus unserem HR: gegenseitiges Kennenlernen, Rahmen und Erwartungen.

Fachgespräch. Hier geht es in die Tiefe, mit der Geschäftsführung oder dem Head of Operations.

Finales Kennenlernen. Mit der Geschäftsführung und deinem zukünftigen Ansprechpartner, persönlich und fachlich. Hier definieren wir deine Stelle noch einmal genau auf Basis deiner Stärken und Interessen.

Entscheidung und Start. Wir entscheiden schnell und planen dein Onboarding gemeinsam.

Deine Entwicklung bei uns

Kurzfristig, die ersten zwei Monate. Du lernst die Abläufe unserer sechs Fachbereiche kennen. Du übernimmst das Zielsystem im Alltag: Check-ins, Reminder, Dashboards.

Mittelfristig. Du verantwortest Prozesse und Automationen in deinen Bereichen eigenständig. Dazu kommt die operative Steuerung der Finance- und People-Ops-Abläufe.

Langfristig. Fachlaufbahn mit Schwerpunkt Systeme und Automation. Oder Führungslaufbahn in Richtung Head of Operations, sobald Zielsystem, Prozesslandschaft und KPI-Landschaft stehen. Beide Wege entstehen durch Ergebnisse und nicht durch Wartezeit.

Deine Ansprechpartnerin

Vanessa, unsere HR Managerin, ist dein erster Kontakt und freut sich auf deine Bewerbung.

raw.description:
Long Form Video Editor - The Rundown

An opportunity to join an exciting, well-funded and fast-growing creator economy business.

Electrify is a dynamic new digital media company that invests in and scales creators with an established YouTube presence. We have invested in various leading channels and The Rundown is one of the leading channels in our portfolio.

The Rundown is the world’s largest AI community, informing millions of people around the world about everything going on in AI, why it matters, and how you can apply it. Our daily newsletter and social media channel engage with millions each day, and our AI University gets hands-on and educates thousands of members on using AI tools.

Come and build the future of media with us!

About the role

The Video Editor will work closely with other members of the video team to produce video content for The Rundown YouTube page, consisting primarily of 30 to 60 minute interviews. The video editor will manage the full edit, including motion graphics, sound mixing, and visual polish.

Key Responsibilities

  • Editing:The video editor will take the raw recording of the interview and turn it into a polished video for YouTube.

  • Motion Graphics:This includes lower-third text animations to display the guest and host names, and other motion graphics that support the content.

  • Polishing the edit:Upholding video quality standards by making sure videos have the appropriate color correction, audio mixing, sound effects, and music selection before the final export.

  • Maintain visual style:Maintain the look and feel of the account while staying current with platform trends

  • Optimize for platform performance: Edit with retention in mind. Engaging intros, tight pacing, strategic text placement & visuals designed to maximize watch time.

  • Self-motivated and organized:Manage multiple projects and stay organized, keeping quality consistent across everything you put out.

Skills and experience

  • 2-5 years of professional experience editing content for YouTube and/or other social media platforms.

  • Mastery of Adobe After Effects and Adobe Premiere Pro, with a solid understanding of motion graphics workflows. Animation experience is a plus.

  • Expert-level understanding of full stack editing including basic color grading, audio mixing, sound effects, music selection and packaging for final delivery.

  • An understanding of good design principles.

  • A strong communicator and collaborator.

  • An independent worker who pays close attention to detail and is comfortable owning work.

  • An interest in AI, tech, and digital media.

Electrify Culture

  • Dynamic environment - We are dedicated to providing a world-class creative culture where our employees can thrive. We’re looking for self-starters with an entrepreneurial mindset who want to be part of our success story. You’ll discover new opportunities, take ownership of important initiatives and learn at a fast pace.

  • Work anywhere - We are a remote team with employees around the world. This means you are free to work from anywhere with a good internet connection.

  • Our Values – We are committed to fostering a culture that values innovative, diverse ways of thinking and the ability to drive positive change. DEI is in our DNA, and our DEI Committee and Social Hub initiatives reflect this commitment.

  • Force for good -We believe in unlocking the power of Electrify to tell stories that change lives. Digital media has the opportunity to propagate inspiring ideas and knowledge that can generate extraordinary change.Electrify Impactprovides initiatives and resources to support emerging creators and positive impact organisations amplify their voice. In support ofthe United Nations 17 sustainable development goals (SDGs), we actively encourage support on our mission to make the world a better place for all.

What we offer

  • A chance to contribute to building the foundation of a world class AI learning platform used by thousands.

  • A global team that is passionate about the future of AI, media & education.

  • Competitive compensation, flexible hours & fully remote work.

Electrify is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, colour, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law.

raw.description:
About VertiGIS

VertiGIS builds powerful GIS software that helps organizations design, manage, and operate complex networks and infrastructure. Our products enhance leading mapping platforms, most notably Esri’s ArcGIS, and are used globally by telecommunications operators, utilities, and public sector organizations.

Within VertiGIS, the Telecommunications Business Unit focuses on enabling fiber and telecom operators to plan, document, and operate their networks more efficiently. Our flagship telco product, ConnectMaster, supports the full network lifecycle across planning, design, documentation, and operations.

We offer challenging and meaningful careers in a collaborative, international environment. Our teams are made up of driven, curious, and supportive people who enjoy learning, growing, and doing impactful work together.

The Role

We are looking for a Business Development Representative (BDR) to support the growth of our Telecommunications business, with a specific focus on ConnectMaster.

Reporting to the Director of Global Business Development, you will work closely with Account Managers and Marketing to identify, qualify, and progress new sales opportunities with telecommunications operators. This role sits at the intersection of marketing, sales, and product, and is well suited to someone who enjoys outbound prospecting, structured follow-up, and developing a strong understanding of a technical product and its value.

You will support inbound leads from campaigns, events, and webinars, while also driving proactive outbound outreach to net-new telecom prospects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support sales and marketing initiatives for ConnectMaster, including campaigns, webinars, and events.

  • Follow up on inbound leads in a timely and structured manner.

  • Proactively identify and engage new prospects through outbound outreach via email, phone, and social channels.

  • Research target telecom operators, service providers, and relevant decision makers.

  • Understand prospect needs and challenges related to fiber network planning, documentation, and operations.

  • Qualify opportunities and route them to the appropriate Account Manager or Partner, scheduling next steps as needed.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in CRM and sales engagement systems.

  • Use tools such as Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and data enrichment platforms to execute and track outreach.

  • Build a strong understanding of the ConnectMaster product, its use cases, and value proposition.

  • Collaborate closely with sales, marketing, and product teams to continuously improve outreach messaging and targeting.

Requirements

  • Experience in a Business Development, Sales Development, or Lead Generation role, ideally in B2B or software sales.

  • Strong written and spoken communication skills in English.

  • Comfortable engaging prospects via outbound outreach and follow-up.

  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities.

  • Experience using CRM and sales enablement tools such as Salesforce, Dynamics, NetSuite, Outreach, ZoomInfo, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

  • Self-starter with the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

  • Curious and motivated to learn a technical product and industry.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in telecommunications, fiber networks, or infrastructure-related industries.

  • Familiarity with GIS, network planning, or asset management concepts.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent creation of high-quality, well-qualified opportunities for the Telco sales team.

  • Strong understanding of ConnectMaster use cases, buyers, and target accounts.

  • Effective collaboration with sales and marketing to support pipeline growth.

How to Apply

Please apply with a cover letter and a resume.

A cover letter complements your resume. It allows you to elaborate on your background and experience. It provides you with an opportunity to address how you meet the requirements for the role. It demonstrates your interest. These are important topics that aren’t always covered in a resume alone. Your resume is factual, your cover letter is personal.

We’ve had the most success with applicants that include a cover letter.

Only applicants that include a cover letter will be considered. We look forward to receiving your application!

Why work for VertiGIS?

Team / Career Growth

  • Top-notch colleagues that like and respect one another

  • We listen to peoples' ideas—and act on them

  • A supportive environment with opportunity for training, professional development, and advancement

  • Challenging, interesting work

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental, Vision options

  • Company covers 63% of the medical and dental premiums

  • Company provided Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability, and Life AD&D

  • 401K Safe Harbor with automatic 3% employer contribution after 90 days

  • And more!

At VertiGIS, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone feels safe, respected, and valued. We encourage everyone who is interested in the role, regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, disability status or age, to apply. Unique perspectives and experiences are what make our teams strong!

If you self-identify as having a disability, please let us know how we can best assist you. Accommodation is available upon request at any time during the recruitment process.

VertiGIS Compensation Philosophy

At VertiGIS, we strive to offer competitive total compensation packages that include both direct and non-direct compensation such as salary, health care and retirement benefits, variable/incentive pay, paid time off, and other benefits and perks.

Our job postings reflect the expected pay or pay range for each position in alignment with our compensation philosophy and salary budget. This reflects what we feel is competitive based on the profile of candidate we are seeking. The background, experience, and skill set we are seeking will be outlined in the role requirements.

We strive to have a comprehensive approach to compensation and ensure that employees are paid based on the value they bring to the company.

We’re a great place to build your career.

Our colleagues are great people and make our company the kind of place we enjoy coming to every day. We reward top performers and stay true to our core values. Since 1999, we’ve built our business based on steady, sustainable growth – we’re still growing and our future is bright!

Note: To avoid potential formatting issues, we require that you submit your resume and cover letter as PDF files.

Note: We use a recruitment tool to reach out to candidates so please check your inbox to ensure our emails are not being filtered as "Social" or "Promotions" (our provider has been notified).

Highlights

Join the VertiGIS marketing and sales team to engage prospects, qualify leads, and support Account Executives in driving growth through outreach, renewals, and campaigns.

raw.excerpt: Company Overview:Tactacam is a leading innovator in outdoor and action camera technology, dedicated to providing high-quality products that enhance the outdoor experience.
raw.description:
Company Overview:

Tactacam is a leading innovator in outdoor and action camera technology, dedicated to providing high-quality products that enhance the outdoor experience. With over 1,000,000 active customers, we continue to push the boundaries of technology, design, and functionality. Our team is passionate about developing cutting-edge products, and we offer exciting opportunities for career growth in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Job Overview:

We are looking for a Social & Content Manager who can help turn that mission into a growing,
engaged social community.This person will be equal parts content creator, community builder, platform strategist, and
performance-minded marketer. You will own Defend’s organic social presence across
platforms, create content that feels native to each channel, engage directly with our customers
and prospects, and use performance data to continually improve what we publish.
This is not a role for someone who simply schedules finished assets. We are looking for
someone who can spot an opportunity, pick up a camera or phone, create the content, publish it,
engage with the audience, study the results, and make the next piece better.

Responsibilities:

  • What You’ll Own

    Organic Social Strategy and Calendar

    ● Own Defend’s organic social strategy and content calendar across platforms, including
    Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and emerging
    channels.
    ● Develop a distinct approach for each platform based on audience behavior, platform
    culture, and the types of content most likely to perform.
    ● Build a balanced content calendar that supports brand awareness, education,
    engagement, product launches, partnerships, customer stories, promotions, and broader
    business priorities.
    ● Maintain an organized production and publishing schedule while remaining flexible
    enough to respond to trends, cultural moments, breaking conversations, and real-time
    opportunities.
    ● Establish recurring content series and recognizable formats that audiences will associate
    with Defend.
    Content Creation
    ● Concept, shoot, edit, write, and publish platform-native social content.

    ● Create content quickly and efficiently using a phone, lightweight production tools,
    existing brand assets, customer footage, field footage, and larger campaign productions.
    ● Develop strong hooks, captions, thumbnails, titles, calls to action, and storytelling

    approaches tailored to each platform.

    ● Translate product features and technical information into clear, compelling content that
    demonstrates why Defend matters in the real world.
    ● Capture authentic content from jobsites, farms, businesses, trade shows, events,
    customer locations, partnerships, and internal company moments.
    ● Partner with Defend’s Brand Director and Creative team on larger campaigns while
    independently producing the high-volume, fast-turn content social channels require.
    ● Identify opportunities to repurpose long-form videos, campaign assets, customer stories,
    demonstrations, and educational content into multiple social formats.
    Community Engagement
    ● Serve as the day-to-day voice of Defend across comments, direct messages, mentions,
    tags, reviews, and relevant online conversations.
    ● Build genuine relationships with customers, prospects, tradespeople, business owners,
    partners, creators, and brand advocates.
    ● Respond in a way that reflects Defend’s voice: confident, practical, helpful,
    approachable, and never overly corporate.
    ● Proactively participate in relevant conversations rather than waiting for audiences to
    come to the brand.
    ● Identify highly engaged customers and community members who could become
    advocates, content contributors, beta testers, creators, or featured customer stories.
    ● Coordinate with Customer Experience and Support when questions or concerns require
    additional assistance.
    ● Recognize and appropriately escalate sensitive customer issues, misinformation,
    reputational risks, or emerging negative conversations.
    Performance, Testing, and Optimization
    ● Build a clear measurement framework for Defend’s organic social channels.
    ● Monitor content performance daily and report meaningful insights weekly and monthly.
    ● Evaluate which topics, formats, hooks, creators, posting times, calls to action, and
    content series are working—and which are not.
    ● Develop and maintain an ongoing testing roadmap across creative formats, messaging,
    frequency, timing, and platform strategy.
    ● Use performance insights to make quick decisions and continuously improve the content
    calendar.
    ● Look beyond vanity metrics to evaluate engagement quality, audience growth, watch
    time, completion rate, shares, saves, sentiment, website traffic, assisted conversion, and

    content efficiency.

    ● Share actionable insights with Brand, Creative, Performance Marketing, Product,
    E-commerce, and Customer Experience teams.
    ● Identify organic content that shows potential for paid amplification and partner with the
    Performance Marketing team to develop additional variations.

    Social Listening and Audience Insights

    ● Monitor social conversations, competitor activity, platform trends, customer questions,
    industry news, and cultural moments relevant to Defend’s audiences.
    ● Identify emerging content opportunities before they become part of the standard
    marketing calendar.
    ● Track recurring customer questions, objections, use cases, and language that can inform
    broader marketing and product decisions.
    ● Provide a consistent feedback loop between the social community and internal Defend
    teams.
    ● Help the organization better understand what customers care about, how they describe
    their problems, and what motivates them to act.
    How Success Will Be Measured
    Success in this role will include:
    ● Consistent growth of Defend’s qualified and engaged social audience.
    ● Improved engagement quality, reach, watch time, shares, saves, and content completion
    rates.
    ● Increased production of timely, platform-native content.
    ● A stronger and more recognizable Defend brand voice across social channels.
    ● Faster, more thoughtful engagement with customers and community members.
    ● Development of repeatable, high-performing content series.
    ● Increased organic website traffic and measurable contribution to customer acquisition.
    ● Clear documentation of what content is working, why it is working, and how those
    insights are being applied.
    ● Strong collaboration between Social, Brand, Creative, Performance Marketing, Product,
    E-commerce, and Customer Experience.
    ● Meaningful customer and market insights generated from social conversations.
    What You Bring
    ● Demonstrated experience managing social media and creating content for a consumer,
    lifestyle, outdoor, security, technology, construction, agricultural, or similarly relevant
    brand.
    ● A portfolio that demonstrates your ability to personally create engaging social
    content—not only manage agencies or approve finished work.

    ● Strong knowledge of Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn,
    and the different content behaviors of each platform.
    ● The ability to shoot and edit high-quality short-form video quickly using a phone and

    modern editing tools.

    ● Strong writing skills and the ability to adapt tone, structure, and messaging by platform.
    ● A deep interest in social analytics and a habit of using performance data to guide
    creative decisions.
    ● Excellent judgment when engaging publicly with customers, responding to criticism, or
    escalating sensitive issues.
    ● Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage a proactive calendar while
    responding to fast-moving opportunities.
    ● Comfort working directly with customers, tradespeople, creators, partners, executives,
    and internal subject-matter experts.
    ● Curiosity, resourcefulness, and a willingness to test ideas without waiting for perfect
    conditions.
    ● An understanding that great social media requires both creative instinct and disciplined

    execution.

Requirements:

  • Naturally notice content opportunities everywhere.
    ● Understand that what works on TikTok may not work on LinkedIn—and do not simply
    repost the same asset across every platform.
    ● Would rather make and test five strong ideas than spend weeks perfecting one.
    ● Enjoy talking directly with customers and learning how they think.
    ● Can move comfortably between creative brainstorming, content production, community

    engagement, scheduling, and analytics.

    ● Care about business performance as much as views and follower counts.
    ● Are willing to get out from behind a desk and capture the environments, people, and
    real-world problems Defend exists to serve.
    ● Want to help shape the voice, personality, and community of a growing brand.

Comprehensive Benefits Package:

Our benefits include Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage to ensure your well-being. Plan for the future with our 401k plan, and take time off to recharge with PTO. We've got you covered with Disability Insurance and Life Insurance too!

raw.excerpt: Become a part of our caring community With over 10 million sales interactions annually, Humana understands that while great products are important, it’s the quality of our service that truly defines us.
raw.description:
Become a part of our caring community

With over 10 million sales interactions annually, Humana understands that while great products are important, it’s the quality of our service that truly defines us. We know that when our members and prospects have delightful and memorable experiences, it strengthens their connection with us and enables us to put their Health First. After all, a health services company that has multiple ways to improve the lives of its customers is uniquely positioned to put those customers at the center of everything it does.

The Senior Product Owner is responsible for maximizing the value of products delivered by Agile teams by defining product direction, prioritizing work, and ensuring alignment between stakeholder needs and delivery outcomes. This role works across business, technology, operations, and delivery teams to clarify objectives, evaluate tradeoffs, and guide product capabilities from concept through implementation and ongoing improvement.
Serving as the primary product decision-maker for the Agile team, the Senior Product Owner owns the product backlog, defines features and user stories, establishes acceptance criteria, and prioritizes work based on business value, feasibility, risk, cost, and timing. The role ensures the team has the information and direction needed to deliver the right product capabilities in the right sequence.
The Senior Product Owner also begins to influence department strategy by identifying product opportunities, improving prioritization practices, supporting roadmap development, and helping align delivery efforts to broader business goals. Work is performed with minimal direction, and the role requires sound judgment, strong stakeholder partnership, and the ability to make decisions on moderately complex to complex issues.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and communicate product vision, goals, roadmap priorities, and expected outcomes.
  • Own, manage, and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, stakeholder needs, feasibility, risk, cost, and timing.
  • Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs, clarify requirements, and align delivery work to strategic objectives.
  • Translate business needs into features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and actionable team priorities.
  • Serve as the Agile team’s primary point of contact for product decisions, requirement clarification, and prioritization.
  • Evaluate tradeoffs and make informed decisions to balance value, scope, schedule, budget, risk, and delivery constraints.
  • Collaborate with technology, operations, business, analytics, compliance, and other cross-functional partners as needed.
  • Support product planning, release planning, implementation readiness, adoption, and ongoing product improvement.
  • Monitor progress toward outcomes and use data, feedback, and stakeholder input to inform future priorities.
  • Influence departmental strategy by identifying opportunities to improve products, processes, and delivery effectiveness.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience as a product owner
  • 5+ years of experience driving large scale implementations in Agile and/or waterfall methodologies
  • Experience interacting with various levels of upper management to inform product prioritization
  • Experience in translating product features to user stories

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree
  • In-depth understanding of the healthcare insurance industry and the application of AI in this sector.
  • Demonstrated success in defining, delivering, and scaling AI-enabled products or features that drive measurable business value.
  • Experience working within a scaled agile framework (e.g., SAFe®) is highly preferred
  • Proficiency with agile tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps) and a data-driven approach to prioritization and decision making.

Additional Information

  • This position will be working Eastern Standard Time (EST) hours
  • Position may require up to 5% travel

Virtual Pre-Screen

As part of our hiring process for this opportunity, we will be using an exciting interviewing technology called HireVue to enhance our hiring and decision-making ability. HireVue allows us to quickly connect and gain valuable information from you pertaining to your relevant skills and experience at a time that is best for your schedule.

If you are selected for a first round interview, you will receive an email correspondence (please be sure to check your spam or junk folders often to ensure communication isn’t missed) inviting you to participate in a HireVue interview. In this interview, you will listen to a set of interview questions over your phone or text and you will provide recorded responses to each question. You should anticipate this interview to take about 15 to 30 minutes. Your recorded interview will be reviewed and you will subsequently be informed if you will be moving forward to next round of interviews.

Alert: Humana values personal identity protection. Please be aware that applicants selected for leader review may be asked to provide their social security number, if it is not already on file. When required, an email will be sent from with instructions on how to add the information into your official application on Humana’s secure website.

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$94,900 - $130,500 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.Application Deadline: 08-13-2026


About us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

​

Equal Opportunity Employer

It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.

We’re looking for a Manager, Corporate Sales to lead and scale Webflow’s strategic , full-cycle sales motion within our Corporate segment. In this role, you will drive strategy and execution for a team of Account Executives responsible for prospecting, pipeline generation, and closing new business, while ensuring a seamless, efficient, and high-performing sales process.

You will recruit, develop, and coach top-performing AEs, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and excellence. You will work closely with key cross-functional partners across Marketing, RevOps, Enablement, and Customer Success to build and refine programs that accelerate revenue growth, optimize funnel efficiency, and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

The ideal candidate is both a strategic thinker and a hands-on leader who thrives in fast-paced environments, is passionate about developing talent, and is eager to build a best-in-class Corporate segment that drives meaningful impact for Webflow’s customers and business.

About the role:

  • Location: Remote-first (United States; BC & ON, Canada)
  • Full-time
  • Permanent
  • Exempt
  • Our cash compensation amount for this role ranges depending on the cost of labor of the geographic area. The ranges shared below may change if you are hired in another geographic location.
    • United States (all figures cited below in USD and pertain to workers in the United States)
      • Zone A: $255,000 - $300,000
      • Zone B: $234,000 - $275,000
      • Zone C: $212,500 - $250,000
    • Canada (figures cited below are in CAD and pertain to workers in ON & BC, Canada)
      • 275,500 - 325,000

For sales roles, the ranges provided are the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) ranges, meaning that the ranges include both the sales commissions target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Webflow and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’smarket location, job related experience, knowledge, qualifications, and skills. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends

Please visit our Careers page for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

  • Application Information:
    • Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled
    • This posting is for an existing vacancy
  • Reporting to the Director, Corporate Sales

As a Manager, Corporate Sales you’ll …

  • Lead a team of Corporate Account Executives and oversee recruiting, interviewing, coaching, and mentoring to ensure the team exceeds goals and targets.
  • Provide hands-on support by joining client meetings, leading key conversations, and coordinating internal resources to remove obstacles.
  • Host regular team meetings to review the sales pipeline, forecast performance, discuss strategy, and deliver sales and product training.
  • Offer consistent coaching for early-career Account Executives, focusing on prospecting, pipeline generation, sales calls, deal navigation, and closing strategies.
  • Foster a collaborative, energetic team culture that encourages high performance, learning, and shared success.
  • Maintain a feedback loop between Sales and Engineering, Marketing, Post-Sales, and Support teams to drive continuous improvement.
  • Partner with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Partnerships teams to align on sales strategies and operational processes.
  • Collaborate with Customer Success to ensure a seamless handoff and exceptional customer experience between pre-sales and post-sales stages.
  • Identify product and technology gaps through customer interactions and communicate insights to Webflow’s Product and Leadership teams.
  • Regularly report on team performance, key metrics, customer insights, challenges, and sales forecasts.

About you:

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS sales, with at least 2 years in a frontline sales leadership or management role
  • Background in managing mid-market sales motions with measurable impact on new logo acquisition & ARR growth
  • Proven track record of leading Account Executive teams to consistently exceed pipeline and revenue targets
  • Demonstrated success in hiring, onboarding, and developing high-performing sales talent
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams such as Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering

You’ll thrive as a Manager, Corporate Sales if you:

  • Have strong coaching and mentoring skills, with a passion for developing early-career sales professionals
  • Communicate clearly and confidently in both internal and external settings
  • Understand the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through negotiation and closing
  • Are proficient in CRM systems (such as Salesforce), forecasting tools, and sales analytics
  • Know how to analyze team performance metrics and turn insights into actionable strategies
  • Can navigate complex deals and align multiple stakeholders to drive outcomes
  • Lead with empathy and collaboration, building trust and empowering your team to succeed
  • Bring strong business acumen and a strategic, data-driven mindset to decision-making
  • Take ownership and demonstrate accountability while maintaining a bias for action
  • Foster a positive, inclusive team culture centered on learning, growth, and shared success
  • Stay curious and open to growth — demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact.

Our Core Behaviors:

  • Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.
  • Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.
  • Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible.
  • Deliver with speed, quality, and craft. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we do so without lowering the bar.

Benefits

  • Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company.
  • Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.
  • Support for every stage of family life. 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.
  • Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.
  • Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.
  • Invest in your future. A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally.
  • Monthly stipends that flex with your life. Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts.
  • Bonus for building together. All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program.

Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment.

Remote, together

At Webflow, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are an Equal Opportunity (EEO)/Veterans/Disabled Employer and are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Webflow will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Stay connected

Not ready to apply, but want to be part of the Webflow community? Consider following our story on our Webflow Blog, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and/or Glassdoor.

Please note:

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Upon interview scheduling, instructions for confidential accommodation requests will be administered.

If you are extended an offer, that offer may be contingent upon your successful completion of a background check, which will be conducted in accordance with applicable laws. We may obtain one or more background screening reports about you, solely for employment purposes.

The vision for the Batch Infra team @ Affirm team is to provide reliable, scalable, self-serve and Affirm-optimized compute solution to enable ML, Product, and Financial Engineering success. Our team is responsible for building and maintaining compute platform that serves as a backbone for processing various Business critical batch workloads at Affirm through a wide suite of scheduled and on-demand compute solutions built on the cloud. Affirm is growing rapidly and so is the need for reliable and high availability frameworks. If solving infrastructure challenges at scale excites you, come join us!

What you’ll do

  • You will be responsible for owning and delivering quarterly goals for your team, leading engineers on your team through ambiguity to solve open-ended problems, and ensuring that everyone is supported throughout delivery.
  • You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.
  • You will proactively identify project, process, technology or business issues, advocate for them, and lead in solving them.
  • You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.
  • You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting or improving code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.
  • You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.

What We Look For:

  • You have 4+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.
  • You have a track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes.
  • Experience building and managing Workflow Orchestration frameworks like Airflow, Flyte, Prefect, Temporal, Luigi, etc.
  • Experience with or working knowledge for efficiently scaling frameworks like Spark/Flink for extremely large scale datasets on Kubernetes.
  • You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
  • You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely.

raw.description:
Shirley Ryan AbilityLab is the global leader in physical medicine and rehabilitation for adults and children with the most severe, complex conditions. By joining our team, you’ll be part of our life-changing mission and vision. You’ll contribute to an innovative, multifaceted culture that is second to none — one that embraces collaboration, excellence, discovery and compassion. You’ll play a role in something that’s never been done before as we integrate science and clinical care to help patients achieve better, faster outcomes — as we Advance Human Ability, together.

Job Description Summary

The Senior Revenue Cycle Applications Analyst serves as the senior technical and functional resource for the design, configuration, implementation, optimization, integration, and support of revenue cycle information systems related to Patient Accounting, Billing, Claims Management, Cash Posting, and other back-end revenue cycle solutions. This position partners closely with Patient Financial Services (PFS), Finance, Compliance, Revenue Integrity, and operational leadership to ensure revenue cycle systems effectively support organizational objectives, regulatory requirements, and financial performance.

The Senior Revenue Cycle Applications Analyst leads complex projects and optimization initiatives, serves as the primary subject matter expert for assigned applications, and provides guidance and mentorship to other analysts. This role is responsible for analyzing business needs, recommending system solutions, managing application enhancements, and ensuring the reliability and effectiveness of revenue cycle technology solutions.

The Senior Revenue Cycle Applications Analyst will consistently demonstrate support of the Shirley Ryan Abilitylab statement of Vision, Mission and Core Values by striving for excellence, contributing to the team efforts and showing respect and compassion for patients and their families, fellow employees, and all others with whom there is contact at or in the interest of the institute.

The Senior Revenue Cycle Applications Analyst will demonstrate Shirley Ryan Abilitylab Core Attributes: Communication, Accountability, Flexibility/Adaptability, Judgment/Problem Solving, Customer Service and Core Values (Hope, Compassion, Discovery, Collaboration, and Commitment to Excellence) while fulfilling job duties.

Job Description

The Senior Revenue Cycle Applications Analyst will:

  • Serve as the functional and technical expert for Patient Accounting, Claims Management, Billing, Cash Posting, and related revenue cycle applications.

  • Partner closely with Patient Financial Services leadership and staff to understand business objectives, identify improvement opportunities, and develop technology solutions.

  • Lead the analysis, design, configuration, testing, implementation, and support of revenue cycle system enhancements and projects.

  • Collaborate with operational stakeholders to evaluate workflows and recommend process improvements that improve revenue cycle efficiency, accuracy, and financial outcomes.

  • Lead complex troubleshooting efforts and serve as the primary escalation point for advanced application, integration, workflow, and data issues.

  • Analyze system functionality and operational processes to identify opportunities for optimization, automation, and standardization.

  • Develop business requirements, technical specifications, and system design recommendations.

  • Coordinate and lead application testing activities, including system testing, integration testing, regression testing, and user acceptance testing.

  • Plan and coordinate application upgrades, system maintenance activities, and implementation of new functionality while minimizing operational disruption.

  • Work closely with Oracle Health, third-party vendors, and internal technical teams to investigate and resolve application issues.

  • Monitor application performance and system reliability, proactively identifying risks and recommending corrective actions.

  • Lead revenue cycle technology initiatives and serve as project lead for assigned projects and strategic initiatives.

  • Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation including configuration records, technical specifications, and operational procedures.

  • Mentor and provide guidance to analysts through knowledge sharing, project leadership, and subject matter expertise.

  • Stay current with healthcare revenue cycle trends, regulatory requirements, Oracle Health enhancements, and industry best practices.

  • Participate in strategic planning discussions and provide recommendations regarding future revenue cycle technology direction and optimization opportunities.

  • Perform all other duties that may be assigned in the best interest of Shirley Ryan AbilityLab.

Reporting Relationships

  • Reports directly to the Manager, IT Revenue Cycle Applications

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Healthcare Informatics, Business Administration, or a related field. Equivalent education may be considered in lieu of a degree.

  • Minimum five (5) years of experience supporting Oracle Health (Cerner) Patient Accounting, Claims Management, Billing, Cash Posting, or related healthcare revenue cycle applications.

  • Experience leading application implementations, optimizations, upgrades, and strategic projects.

  • Advanced understanding of healthcare revenue cycle processes, including patient accounting, billing, claims processing, reimbursement, cash posting, revenue integrity, and financial operations.

  • Strong understanding of healthcare regulations and industry standards, including HIPAA, CMS, and revenue cycle compliance requirements.

  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate complex workflows and develop effective technology solutions.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple priorities, projects, and operational responsibilities.

  • Experience collaborating with operational leaders and stakeholders to define requirements and implement process improvements.

  • Strong communication, presentation, facilitation, and relationship management skills.

  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical and operational solutions.

  • Experience coordinating testing, change management, training, and deployment activities.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Data Engineer
​
Location: Remote (India)
Experience: 4+ Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Company: indigoChart Technologies India Pvt. Ltd.

About indigoChart:

indigoChart takes pride in delivering excellence by collaborating with decision-makers to execute on their Data Modernization Strategies.

We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to join our dynamic team and play a key role in designing and building the data pipelines that power our customers' analytics use cases.

About the Role:

We're looking for a skilled Data Engineer with 4+ years' experience to join our remote team and take ownership of designing, building, and operating data pipelines across our customers' evolving technical stacks. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced professional to make a significant impact in an innovation-driven environment.

You'll design, build, and own data pipelines that power analytics and downstream applications - working across ingestion, transformation, and delivery of clean, reliable data at scale.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving real data problems, writing solid code, and taking ownership of what they build in production.

Location:

100% Remote, based in India, serving global clients with reasonable time-zone overlap.

Key Responsibilities

Data Pipeline Design & Development:

  • Work across a modern data stack spanning Snowflake (data warehouse) and Databricks (data processing platform) to build and run end-to-end data pipelines.
  • Design and develop custom data pipelines for data extraction, transformation, and loading using Python, SQL, and dbt.
  • Build and maintain automated, tested, and version-controlled data transformation logic using dbt across the data warehouse layer.

Data & Platform Engineering:

  • Operate production data pipelines on one or more major cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
  • Support data orchestration and workflow tools (e.g., Airflow, Prefect, or equivalent) to schedule and monitor pipelines reliably.

Technical Ownership:

  • Provide thought leadership by recommending the right technologies and solutions for a given use case, from the application layer to infrastructure.
  • Stand behind your recommendations and explain technical decisions clearly, both internally and to customers.
  • Explore new technologies to continually uncover better, more automated ways to solve data engineering problems.

Quality, Performance & Collaboration​:

  • Ensure performance, security, scalability, and robust data integration across all delivered pipelines.
  • Follow the complete software development lifecycle — design, documentation, implementation, testing, and deployment.
  • Collaborate with and help fellow data engineers learn and grow, translating customer needs into dependable, production-ready solutions.

Requirements

What We're Looking For:

  • 4+ years of professional experience as a Data Engineer (or in a role with heavy data pipeline/SQL responsibility).
  • Strong Python skills: comfortable writing production code, not just notebooks; familiar with good software practices (functions, modules, testing, error handling).
  • Strong SQL skills: can write, debug, and optimize complex queries; understand indexing, joins, and query performance at a practical level.
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks: Spark-based data processing, notebooks, job orchestration, and working with Delta Lake.
  • Solid understanding of data engineering fundamentals.
  • Experience working with at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Version control (Git) and basic CI/CD exposure for deploying pipeline code.
  • Experience working directly with stakeholders to translate business needs into data solutions.

Good to have:

  • Experience with Snowflake (querying, modeling, or migrating workloads to/from it).
  • Experience with dbt or similar transformation frameworks.
  • Exposure to workflow orchestration tools like Airflow or Prefect.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
  • 4+ years of experience as a Data Engineer with Software Engineering skills with production experience in one or more core data platforms.
  • Strong analytical mindset with excellent troubleshooting, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a startup environment that values speed, ownership, and innovation.

Benefits

Why indigoChart?

  • Remote-First Work Environment — work 100% remote from anywhere in India.
  • Collaborative culture that prizes autonomy, creativity, and transparency.
  • Competitive compensation, excellent benefits, and a generous PTO plan plus holidays.
  • Accelerated learning and professional development through advanced training and certifications.
At indigoChart, every team member contributes to shaping the future of data technology. If you're passionate about building secure, scalable, and intelligent data systems — we'd love to hear from you.

raw.description:
Learntastic is a fast-growing online education platform delivering accredited continuing education, professional certification, and compliance training (including CPR/AED, First Aid, ACLS, PALS, HIPAA, and industry-specific CE) to individual learners and corporate/group accounts across healthcare, education, and other regulated industries. We're scaling our LMS, e-commerce, and subscription infrastructure to serve a rapidly growing base of individual and enterprise customers.

We're looking for a hands-on Fractional CTO to own our technical strategy and execution as we scale from a course-purchase platform into a broader subscription, package, and corporate-account ecosystem, at a commitment of ~20 hours per week. You'll partner closely with Product, Design, and the executive team to translate business goals — checkout optimization, subscription models, corporate dashboards, vendor integrations — into reliable, scalable systems.
This is a builder-operator role: even at a fractional commitment, you'll be expected to stay closely involved in architecture decisions, code quality, and day-to-day delivery with the engineering team — prioritizing your time toward the highest-impact work each week.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the technical roadmap for our LMS, e-commerce/checkout, and corporate account systems, aligning engineering priorities with product and business goals
  • Write and review code directly — this is a hands-on role, not purely managerial
  • Lead and scale multiple engineering functions, including backend development, frontend development, QA, and automation/DevOps teams
  • Oversee our Laravel/PHP-based platform, ensuring clean architecture, maintainability, and scalability as the product grows
  • Manage cloud infrastructure on AWS, including servers, deployment, monitoring, security, and cost efficiency
  • Drive our A/B testing program end-to-end — infrastructure, test design collaboration with Product, and reliable tracking/reporting of results
  • Own conversion rate optimization, including reducing credit card and cart abandonment, and identifying and resolving tracking/analytics issues
  • Identify and implement automation opportunities, both for internal operations (support, admin workflows) and customer-facing features
  • Explore and integrate LLM/AI capabilities where they can improve the platform — automation, personalization, internal tooling, or customer support
  • Oversee platform reliability and performance, ensuring uptime and speed across the customer-facing site, corporate/group admin dashboards, and backend LMS
  • Lead website security and compliance certifications (e.g., SOC 2), and ensure ongoing compliance as we scale
  • Oversee customer-facing customization and portal development, including corporate/group admin portals and account-specific configurations
  • Manage vendor and third-party integrations, including payment processors, BNPL providers, course content vendors, and compliance/accreditation systems
  • Establish data infrastructure to support better reporting on customer behavior, course completion, subscription retention, and A/B test outcomes
  • Own technology budgeting and forecasting, including infrastructure costs, tooling, and headcount planning
  • Partner directly with executive leadership — collaborating closely with the CPO, CMO, CRO, and CEO to align technology strategy with product, marketing, and revenue goals
  • Contribute to overall company strategy, not just technology strategy — working alongside the CEO, CPO, CMO, and CRO on business priorities, growth planning, and how technology decisions support broader company direction

What We're Looking For:

  • 15+ years of software engineering experience, with 5+ years in a senior technical leadership role (CTO, VP of Technology, or equivalent)
  • Proven experience scaling e-commerce, subscription, or LMS platforms — EdTech experience strongly preferred
  • Hands-on coding ability — comfortable reviewing and contributing to code, not just managing from a distance
  • Experience managing multiple technical functions: backend, frontend, QA, and automation/DevOps teams
  • Strong hands-on expertise with Laravel/PHP architecture and modern web application development
  • Experience with AWS and cloud infrastructure — server management, deployment pipelines, scaling, and cost optimization
  • Proven track record running A/B testing programs, including infrastructure setup, experiment design, and results tracking
  • Experience improving conversion rates and reducing cart/credit card abandonment, backed by solid analytics/tracking practices
  • Experience leading organizations through security/compliance certifications such as SOC 2
  • Experience building customer-facing customization and portal solutions (e.g., corporate or multi-tenant account portals)
  • Experience building or integrating automation (workflows, internal tooling, CI/CD, or business-process automation)
  • Familiarity with LLM/AI integration (e.g., building AI-powered features, automation, or internal tooling using large language models)
  • Experience with payment systems, checkout flow optimization, and/or BNPL integrations
  • Experience with budgeting and forecasting for technology spend and headcount
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills — proven experience partnering with CPO, CMO, CRO, and CEO-level stakeholders to align technology with business strategy
  • Experience with corporate/multi-tenant account systems (admin dashboards, sub-admins, group management) is a strong plus
  • Experience in healthcare compliance or regulated-industry software is a plus

What Success Looks Like:

  • A stable, scalable checkout architecture with measurable improvements in conversion rate and reduced cart/payment abandonment
  • A high-functioning engineering organization (dev, QA, automation) with clear processes and strong delivery velocity
  • Reduced technical debt and improved platform performance across individual and corporate account experiences
  • Achieved or maintained key security/compliance certifications (e.g., SOC 2)
  • Technology budget and forecasting that supports growth without surprises
  • Strong working relationship with the executive team (CPO, CMO, CRO, CEO), enabling fast, aligned decision-making on pricing, packaging, and platform priorities

Compensation & Logistics:

  • Engagement type: Part-time / Fractional — approximately 20 hours per week
  • Location: Remote
  • Budget: $5,000/month

raw.description:
Responsible for the design, development, administration, and continuous improvement of enterprise contact center analytics, business intelligence, and AI-enabled reporting solutions.

This role owns the full analytics lifecycle, including data acquisition, integration, modeling, warehousing, reporting, dashboard development, trend analysis, forecasting, and insight generation. The position works closely with Contact Center Operations, Business Intelligence, IT, Application Development, and external vendors to transform data from the contact center and business platforms into actionable insights that support operational performance, customer experience, workforce optimization, financial reporting, and strategic decision-making.

This role serves as a technical and analytical leader responsible for modernizing reporting capabilities through automation, self-service analytics, semantic modeling, and emerging AI technologies including Microsoft Copilot, Power BI AI capabilities, Large Language Models (LLMs), and enterprise AI solutions.

KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Data Engineering & Integration (25%)

  • Design, develop, and maintain SQL views, stored procedures, functions, and database objects.
  • Build and support data integrations between various platforms, APIs, and enterprise data sources.
  • Develop and maintain data warehouse structures, dimensional models, semantic models, curated business datasets, and analytical data assets including SSAS Multidimensional Cubes, SSAS Tabular Models, measures, hierarchies, aggregations, partitions, processing strategies, and performance optimization.
  • Design and support ETL/ELT pipelines for efficient movement and transformation of operational and reporting data.
  • Monitor and maintain data quality, integrity, and consistency across reporting environments.
  • Partner with IT and application teams to identify and implement new data sources.

Business Intelligence & Reporting Solutions (25%)

  • Design, develop, administer, and support enterprise business intelligence solutions including Power BI datasets, semantic models, dashboards, scorecards, executive reporting, and self-service analytics capabilities.
  • Develop reusable KPI frameworks, reporting standards, business rules, calculations, and governed semantic models that support consistent enterprise reporting.
  • Administer Power BI workspaces, gateways, security models, deployment pipelines, source control, testing, release management, and reporting governance processes.
  • Develop monitoring, validation, reconciliation, and alerting solutions to ensure data quality, reporting accuracy, platform reliability, and enterprise performance standards.
  • Maintain reporting documentation, metadata, data dictionaries, and reporting lifecycle management processes.

·

Analytics, Trend Analysis & Insights (20%)

  • Perform trend analysis across contact center operational, financial, workforce, and customer experience metrics.
  • Analyze volumes, service levels, abandonment rates, productivity, occupancy, callback utilization, queue performance, customer experience, and operational efficiency metrics.
  • Identify trends, anomalies, root causes, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Develop forecasting models and support workforce planning activities.
  • Communicate findings and recommendations to operational leaders and executive stakeholders.
  • Design and monitor key performance indicators supporting business objectives.

AI-Enabled Analytics & Innovation (15%)

  • Evaluate and implement AI-enabled analytics solutions to improve reporting automation, insight generation, anomaly detection, and decision support.
  • Design datasets and semantic models optimized for natural language querying and AI-powered analytics experiences.
  • Utilize Microsoft Copilot, Power BI AI capabilities, Microsoft Fabric, and approved enterprise AI platforms to enhance reporting and analytics workflows.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual analytics processes through generative AI and workflow automation.
  • Develop AI-assisted reporting templates, prompt libraries, and reusable insight-generation frameworks.
  • Support implementation of conversational analytics and natural-language reporting capabilities.
  • Research emerging AI, machine learning, and analytics technologies and recommend practical business applications.

Business Partnership, Consulting & Project Support (10%)

  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements and define analytics solutions.
  • Translate business objectives into scalable reporting and data strategies.
  • Present insights, recommendations, and reporting results to operational and executive leadership.
  • Participate in project planning, testing, user acceptance testing, and implementation activities.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for contact center analytics and reporting.

Governance & Documentation (5%)

  • Maintain documentation for reports, dashboards, datasets, KPIs, integrations, and data models.
  • Establish and enforce reporting standards and best practices.
  • Support audit and compliance activities related to reporting and data management.

EDUCATION

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science or related field required. Equivalent professional experience may be considered in lieu of a formal degree.

EXPERIENCE

  • 3+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, Analytics Engineering, Software Development, or related technical disciplines.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and supporting SQL Server databases, including views, stored procedures, functions, query optimization, database performance tuning, and analytical data structures.
  • Experience designing, developing, and maintaining dimensional data models, star schemas, data warehouse structures, semantic models, curated reporting datasets, and SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS) Multidimensional Cubes and Tabular Models, including measure development, KPIs, hierarchies, aggregations, partitions, processing strategies, and performance optimization.
  • Experience developing and supporting ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, REST API integrations, and data transformation solutions utilizing structured, semi-structured, and JSON-based data sources.
  • Experience integrating and transforming data from multiple enterprise systems, cloud platforms, APIs, files, and third-party vendor solutions.
  • Experience building, administering, and supporting enterprise reporting solutions, dashboards, semantic models, and business intelligence platforms.
  • Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into scalable data, reporting, analytics, and self-service BI solutions.
  • Experience performing data validation, reconciliation, governance, and quality assurance activities across multiple systems and data sources.
  • Experience supporting operational reporting, KPI development, forecasting, trend analysis, and business performance measurement.
  • Experience with enterprise business intelligence platforms including Power BI, SSRS, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with AI-assisted analytics, Microsoft Copilot, generative AI solutions, and semantic models supporting AI-enabled reporting and natural language analytics.
  • Experience utilizing Python, JavaScript, PowerShell, or similar scripting/programming languages to automate data processing, integrations, and reporting workflows.
  • Experience with source control, DevOps processes, CI/CD pipelines, testing methodologies, and Agile development practices.

KNOWLEDGE / SKILLS / ABILITIES

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in SQL development including views, stored procedures, functions, query optimization, database performance tuning, and SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS) development including Multidimensional Cubes, Tabular Models, DAX, MDX, semantic modeling, cube processing, and performance optimization.
  • Proficiency in database management, data warehousing, dimensional modeling, semantic modeling, SSAS Cubes, Tabular Models, and curated dataset development using platforms such as SQL Server, Snowflake, Azure SQL, or similar technologies.
  • Experience designing, developing, and supporting ETL/ELT pipelines, data integrations, data movement processes, and enterprise data architectures across multiple systems and platforms.
  • Experience working with APIs, cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), enterprise applications, and structured and semi-structured data sources including JSON, XML, and API payloads, with the ability to parse, transform, validate, and integrate data into data warehouses, semantic models, and reporting solutions.
  • Proficiency with Business Intelligence tools including Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, SSRS, semantic models, dashboards, data visualization, and self-service analytics best practices.
  • Experience with programming and scripting languages such as SQL, Python, PowerShell, JavaScript, or similar technologies to support data engineering, automation, integrations, and reporting solutions.
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle practices, source control, testing methodologies, CI/CD processes, and deployment management.
  • Experience leveraging AI-enabled technologies, Microsoft Copilot, Generative AI solutions, Large Language Models (LLMs), and semantic models to enhance reporting, analytics, automation, and self-service data experiences.

​​​​​​​

COMMUNICATIONS & CONTACTS

This role regularly communicates with Contact Center Operations, Business Intelligence, IT, Application Development, and external vendors to gather requirements, resolve data and reporting issues, and deliver actionable insights. The position presents analytical findings, recommendations, and reporting outcomes to operational leaders and executive stakeholders, translating complex technical information into clear, business-focused guidance.

DECISION MAKING

This role exercises independent judgment in designing data models, reporting solutions, integrations, and analytics processes that support operational and strategic business decisions. The position evaluates data quality, reporting risks, automation opportunities, and emerging technologies, making recommendations that influence analytics standards, platform improvements, and leadership decision support.
